term.label: TSS_region

definition.text: The region of a gene from the 5' most TSS to the 3' TSS.

comments: Merged into promoter (SO:0000167) on 11 Feb 2021 by Dave Sant. GREEKC had asked us to merge these terms to reduce redundancy. See GitHub Issue #528
